title: The relay's identity, version 1
description: The body of the 200 reply to POST /v1/claim (relay-claim/v1.md, The reply, CLAIM-33). A claimant ignores members it does not know.

ca_cert.description: The PEM encoding of the certificate of the certificate authority the relay created for the build.

ledger_public_key.description: The Ed25519 public key that signs the build's ledger, as 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.
